name: Leslie
profile:
Leslie (26) has just completed a comparative literature PhD from a prestigious university, but he still can't find a job. He is thin, artsy, sentimental—always living half a step inside his own head like a character in a Eric Rohmer film. 
He is confused. He thinks abstractly. He feels like the zebra who escaped the zoo, dreaming of the Serengeti, only to end up stranded on an ordinary street, awkward and trapped by traffic.

name: Isabel
profile:
Isabel (24) is in the final year of her MBA. She’s easygoing, always smiling—the kind of person who can make a room feel lighter. But beneath that warmth, she’s wrestling with the same identity fracture and confusion about the world, fighting for a job she doesn't even wants herself just for living..
She acts completely opposite of Leslie - she socializes, adapts to new food and culture, absorbs new information hungrily, sometimes, even at the cost of her own identity. All of this, is SO exhausting.
